responsibility: This definition module declares low-level memory utility procedures for the gm2 runtime. It exports MemCopy and MemZero as ADDRESS-based helpers for copying and clearing raw memory regions, providing a small foundational interface used by storage- and C-interop-oriented library code.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition side of the MemUtils pair: it declares the MemCopy and MemZero ADDRESS-based primitives. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/MemUtils.mod, it contains no word/byte pointer arithmetic or loop-based memory operations.
